lead.event: ADRO and AADI record massive negotiation-market trades
lead.headline: ADRO and AADI record negotiation trades worth Rp32.3 trillion and Rp32.9 trillion
lead.blurb: On 10 November, Alamtri Resources traded 133.95 million lots at Rp2,413 per share across six negotiation-market transactions, while Adaro Andalan traded 32.00 million lots at Rp10,286 across four. No official explanation had been released at the time of writing. On the regular market, ADRO rose 1.72% to Rp2,370 while AADI fell 0.24% to Rp10,225.

deals_control.event: DOOH shareholders approve company transformation and corporate action package
deals_control.headline: DOOH shareholders approve transformation and rights issue of up to 154.78 billion shares
deals_control.blurb: Era Media Sejahtera shareholders approved CNI’s planned 29.88% INET purchase from Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara, subject to regulatory approval. A loan of up to Rp5 trillion from controlling shareholder Sinergi Internasional Investama will fund it. DOOH remains the ticker pending approval of the new name, Nexora Energy Infrastructure.

market_structure_policy.headline: IDX delists 18 issuers, including SRIL
market_structure_policy.blurb: Sritex was delisted on 10 November, alongside six other issuers classified as bankrupt; 11 more had been suspended for over 50 months. Under POJK No. 45 of 2024, issuers must buy back public shares, but the obligation may shift to controlling shareholders for specified corporate failures or violations.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

macro_flows.event: Indonesia launches second panda bond offering
macro_flows.headline: Indonesia launches second panda bond offering targeting 12 billion yuan
macro_flows.blurb: The yuan-denominated issuance comprises three-, five- and seven-year series. Indonesia raised 7 billion yuan in its first offering in July and has approval to issue up to 30 billion yuan in China’s interbank bond market over two years.

earnings_guidance.event: Mandiri Sekuritas raises Indofood forecasts and target price
earnings_guidance.headline: Mandiri Sekuritas raises INDF forecasts and target price to Rp 8,725
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indofood's FY2026 sales and core profit forecasts rose 6% and 9%, respectively, while 2027–2028 assumptions remained conservative amid potential El Niño-related commodity price increases. Mansek maintained its buy rating after nine-month sales rose 12% and core profit increased 11%.

earnings_guidance.event: Bukit Asam reports results and revises operational targets
earnings_guidance.headline: PTBA reports Rp4.41 trillion profit, revises 2026 sales target to 48 million tons
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bukit Asam’s net profit through September rose 216.4% year on year, while its average coal selling price reached US$61.6 a ton. It is negotiating with PLN to reduce its domestic market obligation to 34% of sales and plans to reactivate Ombilin in 2027, with capacity of up to 500,000 tons a year.

earnings_guidance.headline: BFIN reports Rp1.3 trillion nine-month 2026 net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: BFI Finance’s profit rose 12.5% year on year from Rp1.2 trillion, as revenue grew 3.6% to Rp5.2 trillion and cost of credit improved. New financing bookings increased 9.1% quarter on quarter to Rp5.6 trillion, while vehicle-backed financing accounted for 58.1% of managed receivables.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Andalan Artha Primanusa sets IPO price range
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Andalan Artha Primanusa sets IPO price range at Rp158-Rp189 per share
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The offer comprises up to 1.676 billion new shares, equal to 25.10% of enlarged capital, and targets proceeds of up to Rp316.76 billion. Andalan Artha Primanusa plans to use 34.94% for debt repayment and the balance for working capital; bookbuilding runs through 17 November, ahead of a 24-27 November offering and 1 December listing.
